summary: Delta is sound on its core constraints: the 4-connected flood only clears edge-connected pixels whose min(R,G,B)>=240, so the red diamond border (and its anti-alias ramp) blocks it and the enclosed white GHS field stays opaque; pictograms still come only from the approved table crops; the lru_cache key is the absolute per-asset Path so no cross-asset contamination; NFPA ratings, quadrant colors, white special quadrant and internal data-nfpa-* metadata survive the caption/panel removal. One medium layout regression: removing the opaque white NFPA panel exposes footer supplier text that is clamped by character count, not against the diamond's pixel position, so long custom supplier name/address can now visibly overlap the colored diamond. Plus three low items on test guard strength and cache keying.

findings.location: app/label_stub.py:350-358 (supplier text), app/label_stub.py:360-379 (nfpa-704 group, panel rect removed), app/label_stub.py:1868-1882 (char-count clamp), app/label_stub.py:1572-1580 (nfpa_panel_x / emergency_box_width)
findings.defect: Footer supplier name/address are clamped only by character count (_fit_text, 50 and 70 chars) and never against nfpa_panel_x. With the opaque white panel rect gone, overflowing supplier text is no longer painted over and now collides with the colored NFPA diamond. Worst realizable case at the narrowest Jinja-footer width (612, show_clearedge_mark true): process_mark_x=412, nfpa_panel_x=412-104-12=296, diamond left edge=296+16=312; a 50-char supplier name at font-size 10.5 measured with the repo's own estimator (_estimated_text_width_units, ~0.60 units/char) is ~315px from x=20, right edge ~335; a 70-char address at font-size 8 is ~308px, right edge ~328. Both cross 312. All three supplier lines (height-77, height-63, height-50) lie inside the diamond's vertical span (height-82..height-10).
findings.reasoning: Supplier name and address are required US label content on a printed compliance artifact, and the ticket objective is legibility. The emergency box already reserves footer width (line 1580, reserved_footer_width) but supplier text does not, so the panel rect was the only thing masking the overflow. ClearEdge defaults (41-char address, ~196px right edge) stay clear, which is why the CE SilaCure SC inspection showed no overlap; custom long supplier strings are not covered by that evidence. Minimal fix: clamp the three supplier lines with _fit_text_for_width against (nfpa_panel_x - 20 - 8) when show_nfpa, mirroring the reservation at line 1580.

findings.defect: The interior-opacity guard asserts alpha only at (0,0), (w-1,h-1) and the exact center. If the flood ever leaked through an anti-aliased apex on an asset whose center pixel is dark symbol ink (e.g. GHS02 flame), the enclosed white field around that ink could be cleared while the center pixel stays alpha 255 and the test still passes.
findings.reasoning: The required white field inside the red diamond is the one hard constraint of this delta, and the regression guard can miss a partial interior clear on some assets. Minimal fix: for each asset also assert alpha==255 at a known white interior offset just inside the red border.

findings.defect: lru_cache keys only on path. A missing asset caches None for the process lifetime, and an in-place replacement of an approved crop keeps serving the pre-replacement transformed bytes until restart; no mtime/size in the key.
findings.reasoning: Approved-asset provenance is a project invariant; a silently stale or permanently-None pictogram would be served with no warning after the first call. Minimal fix: key on (path, st_mtime_ns, st_size), or skip caching the None result.

findings.defect: The no-caption regression only checks inside the nfpa-704 group body for "NFPA 704", "SUPPLEMENTAL" and "<rect". A caption or panel reintroduced as a sibling outside the group would pass this test; the whole-SVG assertion exists only in the unrated case (line 754).
findings.reasoning: The user requirement is no visible caption or panel anywhere on the label, so the guard for the source-backed path is weaker than the requirement. Minimal fix: assert "SUPPLEMENTAL" and "NFPA 704" absent from the full svg in test_source_backed_nfpa_values_render_in_standard_orientation.
